_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for class labels. recognizer.py, server.py, the tests and the front end all check against this file. To add a class: add it here, add a rule in recognizer.py AND an entry in SIGNS in frontend/index.html (tests/test_contract.py fails if they drift apart).

model.name: rule-based hand geometry (NOT a trained ML model)
model.input: 21 MediaPipe hand landmarks (x, y, z), one hand

sentinels.UNKNOWN: A hand is visible but the pose matches no supported class
sentinels.NO_HAND: No hand visible in the frame

word_model.name: ISL word recogniser: nearest-neighbour on recorded 10-frame clips
word_model.input: 1-2 hands x 21 MediaPipe landmarks over ~1.5 s
